source_caveats.final_e: Completed exploration. This process loaded while the redundant output-order check was removed. The wrapper hashes the source at process end, so its c10469... field cannot establish the exact loaded source version. All nine requests are retained, excluded from the primary four-run aggregate.

limits: Serial fresh processes, no locked clocks or controlled desktop background/temperature; runs were not randomized.
Per group and case: six hot requests from two runs. Per fixed implementation and case: three hot replays. Small samples do not establish a statistical speedup.
First PCM equals almost the complete request because each request emits one PCM block. Worker ready plus first PCM excludes process startup/top-level imports and is not full cold-start latency.
Complete-request tree RSS/private are sampled every 100 ms and may miss peaks or count shared pages more than once; CPU-s is thread-summed process time, not whole-system CPU percentage.

Fixed replay memory snapshots cover the current PID only, after gc and 150 ms settling; WDDM committed is not resident or exclusive GPU memory and must not be added to RSS. Missing instances are not zero.
ORT provider profiling and timer wrappers run separately from normal timings; run/synchronize are host-observed wall times, not pure GPU kernel time.
No new listening, ASR, multi-request concurrency, power or discrete-GPU measurements. Genie remains the separate earlier comparison.
